# SANDA — Backpack & Bag OEM/ODM Manufacturer, Guangzhou

> SANDA is a backpack and bag OEM/ODM manufacturer in Guangzhou, China. Founded in 2019, it runs a 7,000 m² factory with seven dedicated production lines and ships 50,000+ pieces a month. It makes seven bag families — laptop, hiking, school, tote, duffle, sling and waist — for brands, retailers and promotional buyers, either from ready-to-ship stock or fully custom.

## Key facts

- Founded 2019 in Guangzhou, China
- Factory 7,000 m², seven dedicated production lines
- Capacity 50,000+ pieces per month
- MOQ 100 units for ready-to-ship styles; 300 units per design for full custom
- First samples in 7–10 days
- 500+ materials in stock
- 300+ new styles designed each year
- Quote turnaround 2–4 hours
- 100% NDA on request
- 15 production steps, from incoming material to container loading
